summary.text: Neal Schwartz is the Democratic candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Jill Dickman.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired businessman and a realtor for nearly 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Schwartz said in his Ballotpedia survey that his business career spanned real estate, film, residential and commercial development, and trade shows and conferences in the hazardous waste industry.
He said he held an AEC Top Secret clearance and a Department of Defense Secret clearance, and produced training films for the astronauts on Skylab.
Schwartz listed among his campaign messages making sure first responders have the resources they need, finding ways to add state revenue without raising taxes, and protecting the right to vote.

He also wrote about housing affordability and about fixing traffic congestion in Sparks and the North Valleys, and said he is passionate about having the Legislature meet every year rather than every other year.
